# HLPatcher

> Free, open-source patcher that makes Half-Life and other Valve games run natively on Apple Silicon Macs (M1 and newer).

## Docs

- [Home](https://hlpatcher.org/): What HLPatcher is, its features and credits
- [Supported Games](https://hlpatcher.org/supported-games/): Every game HLPatcher can patch
- [Getting Started](https://hlpatcher.org/getting-started/): Download HLPatcher and patch your games
- [Removing Patches](https://hlpatcher.org/removing-patches/): Restore your original game files
- [Contributing](https://hlpatcher.org/contributing/): Development setup, testing and pull requests
